ruleName: Ball Played from Anywhere Other Than Putting Green Strikes Power Line; Ball in Motion Accidentally Hits Person, Animal or Object
title: Ball Strikes Overhead Power Line
question: Your tee shot strikes an overhead power line stretching across the fairway before bouncing into the rough. What is the correct ruling?

choices.text: You must always replay the stroke.
You always play the ball as it lies.
It depends. If the Committee has adopted a Local Rule requiring a replay, you must replay the stroke. Otherwise, you play the ball as it lies.
You receive a one-stroke penalty and play the ball from where it finished.

explanation: There is no Rule of Golf that automatically requires a stroke to be replayed after a ball hits an overhead power line or cable. However, many golf courses adopt Model Local Rule E-11, which requires a player to cancel the stroke and replay it if the ball hits a specified power line or supporting structure. If no such Local Rule is in force, the ball is played as it lies after striking the power line. Always check the Local Rules before starting your round.
